title: Kapelle application config (.claude/kapelle.config.json)
description: Minimal SDLC configuration. Project capabilities and knowledge providers are discovered natively by Claude Code and are not registered here.

artifact_root.description: Project-relative root for durable feature artifacts.

modules.description: Optional module boundaries used only as task context, never for capability routing.

guidance_evidence.description: Whether implementation tasks must report project-guidance evidence. Kapelle does not prescribe how guidance is obtained.

implementation.description: Generic execution settings. Agent-team mode remains subject to runtime availability, explicit user approval, and safe task partitioning.

checkpoint.description: Human progress checkpoint during production implementation. It never removes amendment or final approval gates.

validation.description: Permission policy for project validation commands during implementation. Final review and ship still require passing evidence.

development_policy.description: ask prompts with the exact batch; allow runs it; skip defers it. /kapelle:implement --validation=... may override this for one invocation.

providers.description: Optional provider adapter policies. Core role profiles (dispatcher/role-profiles.json) declare reasoning and cost intent only; a provider adapter maps a role or stage to a concrete model or effort here. Kapelle core never names a model. Unbound roles inherit the session default.

roles.description: Bindings for Kapelle agent roles, keyed by agent name.

stages.description: Bindings for Kapelle stages, keyed by skill name.

path.description: Path prefix used to provide module context.
